civil_id.label: Civil ID
civil_id.notes: Issued by PACI. Required for all residents. Renewal at PACI branches or online.

residency.label: Residency Permit
residency.notes: Article 18 (private sector) or Article 20 (dependent). Late renewal incurs 2 KD/day fine. Renewal requires valid passport, medical, and employer sponsorship.

work_permit.label: Work Permit
work_permit.notes: Issued by Public Authority for Manpower. Tied to residency and employer sponsorship.

passport.label: Passport
passport.notes: Employee responsibility. Must have 6+ months validity for residency renewal. Employer tracks for visa purposes.

medical.label: Medical Fitness Certificate
medical.notes: Required for initial residency and some renewals. Done at designated MOH clinics.

60.description: Notify HR via WhatsApp about upcoming expiry.

30.description: Notify HR with urgency. Request updated documents from employee via WhatsApp.

15.description: Urgent alert to HR. Follow up with employee if no response.

7.description: CRITICAL alert to HR. Daily follow-up with employee.

0.description: OVERDUE. Daily alert to HR until resolved. Include fine calculation if applicable.
